svg.title: Plugins: one real call, the row you can swap and the code that judged it
svg.desc: Five numbered steps of one real call, Goldwind on 2026-10-08. One: the factors row, drawn as a module in its socket with an empty socket for a row of your own beside it, computed one reading: trend off, price 31.8 percent under its 200-day average. Two: the model argued a bull case and a bear case over that reading. Three: the plan on paper, watch, act only above 8.97 within five sessions, dead at 8.923, confidence 0.34. Below a line marked "not rows": four, a chart of Goldwind's eight daily bars to 2026-10-09 with the act and dead prices ruled across it; code took the open of 2026-10-08, 8.645, as the reference, marked the next close, 8.28, 4.22 percent lower and called it a loss. Five, the ledger entry as it is stored, decision dec-6d9e8bdc8817 with its outcome. No row can mark its own call, pick a kinder reference, change the outcome or keep it off the ledger.

text.tspan: Swap what computes. Not what a result is allowed to do.
One real call, Goldwind · 02208, 2026-10-08: which step was a row, and which were not.
One row, one socket, one reading
Twelve more live rows sit in sockets
A row turns inputs into a reading, and nothing more.
A row declares its inputs, its units and what it holds when it cannot measure. A broken row fails alone.
The only one of its peers with
act on, and the book has
watch, and write the trigger down before price gets there
A number the market can prove wrong,
on paper before the price gets there.
NOT ROWS FROM HERE DOWN · THE SAME CODE JUDGES EVERY STRATEGY
NOT THE MODEL · NOT THE ROW
Reference: the first price it could have traded at after the plan
was published. Marked at the next session’s close.
The track record the next brief reads
turn this loss into something else
Replace the factors row and Goldwind’s line is computed another way. Steps 04 and 05 do not move.
